order: Counterbalanced AB/BA; opaque equal-length workspaces; each run fresh client process/home and identical saved source; no simultaneous timed sessions
timing: Client spawn through exit, including MCP startup, actual retrieval and model/tools; copy/setup, index preparation and independent grader measured separately
quality: Predeclared external behavior/fuzz/export checks, protected-source audit and 1.25x CPU gates for two optimization tasks. No artificial mutations or oracle exposed to agents.
installed_integration: MCP tool availability plus the installed project skill; no forced tool call or injected answer. Adoption reported, including CM-enabled runs that never call CM.
caveats: Single project/device; six tasks with two stochastic repetitions
Source-and-test snapshot, excludes media and native build dependencies; pure code tasks, no full game FPS claim
A ready copied projection is used; fresh full indexing cost is separate
Primary comparisons are within each client; different models across clients are not directly ranked
Follow-up motivated by low spontaneous CM adoption in primary Claude; separately reported, same tasks are not a new held-out dataset. One repetition, fresh balanced pairs, no product tuning.
